COMMERCIAL: Homo Xtra (HX), "The one. The only. The original."
1. Andy Humm and Ann Northrop discuss recent general events that relate to the LGBT community.
2. Footage from CSPAN of Nancy Pelosi, Democratic Representative for the House of Representatives, regarding "Domestic Partners and Employees Benefits" legislation.
3. Footage from NY1 of US Senate press conference. Includes footage of politicians Betsy McCaughey Ross, Margarita Lopez, James Larocca, Geraldine Ferraro, and Alan Hevesi, and activist Andy Humm.
4. Footage from News at Ten of the Gay Games at Amsterdam.
6. Interview: Joe Calarco, production adapter and director, discusses his all-male play "Shakespeare's R & J". Includes performance footage.
7. Callen - Lorde Community Health Center Update.
COMMERCIAL: National Foundation for Infectious Diseases, C. Everett Koop, PSA for Hepatitis A
9. Interview: Arthur Hanket, playwright and actor, discusses his solo play "Saint Genet: Language of the Wall". Includes performance footage.
